title: Replace Somers Scheduler logo with provided blob URL across UI

requirements.summary: Centralize the app logo source and update all UI logo render locations to use the provided blob URL consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen logo renders using the provided blob URL (no remaining reference to `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png` for the logo).
Top bar/header logo renders using the provided blob URL (no remaining reference to `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png` for the logo).
A project-wide search shows no remaining usage of `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png` for app branding/logo rendering (excluding unrelated assets).
Logo alt text remains in English (e.g., "Somers Scheduler").

file_operations.description: Create a single source of truth for branding constants, including the app logo URL set to `https://blob.caffeine.ai/v1/blob/?blob_hash=sha256%3A5e8468951155e9387499978e83162188afd39a6d2ce119a1b96650eded40facf&owner_id=bjzp7-xyaaa-aaaaf-qbsta-cai&project_id=0198d89b-d4eb-711d-abfd-9b50202a1152` and a stable English alt text (e.g., "Somers Scheduler").

Add a small reusable AppLogo component that reads the logo URL and alt text from `frontend/src/lib/branding.ts` and renders the logo image for use in multiple UI locations (do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui`).

Replace the login screen logo `` currently using `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png` with the new AppLogo (or branding constant) so it renders from the provided blob URL; keep alt text in English. Ensure no other logo references remain in this file.

Replace the top bar/header logo `` currently using `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png` with the new AppLogo (or branding constant) so it renders from the provided blob URL; keep alt text in English. Also perform a local check within this file to ensure there are no remaining references to the old generated logo path.
